data.name: Ranger
data.description: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses ranger as his secondary class gains the following secondary class features.

raw_tokens.value: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses ranger as his secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;Track: At 3rd level, he gains the track class feature, treating his character level as his effective ranger level.
&nl;Favored Enemy: At 7th level, he gains the 1st favored enemy class feature.
&nl;Favored Terrain: At 11th level, he gains the 1st favored terrain class feature.
&nl;Expert Tracker: At 15th level, he gains the woodland stride and swift tracker class features.
&nl;Quarry: At 19th level, he gains the quarry class feature.
